messages:
release-checker-bot: preflight FAILED — env-parity check for release 2026-03-20-17:59
release-checker-bot: staging has `inference_keystore_suffix`='-v2' but prod has none. model pin `mymodel@20260320` only in staging. Promotion blocked.
alex: cc @maria @steph @tariq — release is blocked, scheduled in 10m. what's the fastest unblock?
maria: staging turned on a tiny canary that writes suffixed keystore entries. prod wasn't seeded. we can either remove suffix from staging, seed prod, or implement runtime fallback.
steph: shim in runtime to try suffixed key then fallback to legacy key? should be quick and low-risk.
tariq: shim is fine. seeding prod secret requires infra write + approval. that takes longer.
jen: risk note — if we accidentally serve a mix of keys we could hit stale model cache; avoid mid-request model changes.
alex: options:
  A) rollback staging change (lose canary data)
  B) quick runtime fallback shim + pin model version
  C) seed prod keystore with suffixed keys (needs infra approval)
steph: leaning B. implement fallback and pin `mymodel@20260320` so routing is deterministic.
maria: I'll open a tiny PR adding `INFER_KEY_SUFFIX` fallback and a canary flag. will include release notes and a revert plan. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pulls/4321
infra-bot: prod write requires approval from infra-ops-team. start approval workflow? (yes/no)
alex: start approval but don't block rollout on it. proceed with shim + pin first.
release-coordinator-bot: change-window extended +45m. holding canary promotion until CI + monitoring green.
tariq: coordinating with infra for the secret seed if approval comes through. otherwise we keep the shim and revert later.
jen: release notes draft: "Staging used experimental keystore suffix for canary model variants. Runtime now attempts suffixed key then falls back to legacy key. Model pinned to mymodel@20260320 to avoid mixed-variant serving. Prod will be seeded with suffixed keys after infra approval; shim to be removed after parity confirmed."
steph: local unit tests added and manual smoke passed. code snippet:
```py
# fallback logic
def get_model_key(base_key, suffix):
    if suffix:
        for k in (base_key + suffix, base_key):
            val = keystore.get(k)
            if val: return val
    return keystore.get(base_key)
```
maria: reviewed, lgtm, merging once CI passes.
alex: merging now. @monitoring please watch model-cache-mismatch alert.
ops-bot: monitoring: alert `model-cache-mismatch` created and snoozed for 30m. escalation set to SRE on-call.
release-coordinator-bot: release unblocked; promoting canary after CI. follow-up: postmortem-ish note in #postmortems after 24h.
